description:
Search for current scholarship pages to review. A page in the result is a research lead, not a verified match. Confirm program terms, deadline, and student eligibility on the sponsor page before advising the student. Live web search makes this slower and costlier than the other analysis tools.

Cost: about 165 credits (~$0.165) per call.

backgrounds.description: Eligibility categories that unlock specific award pools.

major.description: Intended field. Departmental awards are usually the least contested.

notes.description: Anything else that should shape the output.

state.description: State of residence. State and regional awards have far smaller applicant pools than national ones.

studentName.description: The student this is about. Used in the output text.
